vo/k1a.mp3.text: Your call is important to us.

vo/k1b.mp3.text: Did you know? FlexZone members who visit live longer.

vo/k4.mp3.text: To cancel your membership, say: cancel.

vo/z6.mp3.text: [booming, commanding] Dale Krupnik! Do NOT finish that word.

vo/d8.mp3.text: Forty-seven minutes! If this call drops, I swear to God...

vo/d10.mp3.text: It's thirty-five bucks a month. I don't even go.

vo/z9.mp3.text: [solemn] I am Zeth, Prime Auditor of the Galactic Reserve. Nine trillion beings need you to keep that membership.

vo/q12.mp3.text: [excited, fast] Eleven years, zero visits! But every Sunday night, you sincerely intend to start Monday. Five hundred and seventy-three Mondays in a row!

vo/z14.mp3.text: Every currency needs something that never changes. We tried gold. We tried the speed of light... which turned out to be negotiable. Then, we found you.

vo/q15.mp3.text: [cheerful] You're more stable than the proton! Protons decay eventually. You are never going to do anything!

vo/d16.mp3.text: [offended] Okay, hey. I wrestled in high school.

vo/d20.mp3.text: [sly] So... what's that worth to you?

vo/z19.mp3.text: [grave] The pensions of forty thousand worlds, Mister Krupnik, are stored in your thighs.

vo/z21.mp3.text: Name it. A moon. A sun. Immortality.

vo/d22.mp3.text: I want the good parking spot at work. The one by the door.

vo/d24.mp3.text: And I want Greg to know I got it.

vo/b29.mp3.text: [shouting, hyped] DALE! Brad, from FlexZone! Your free training session, mate! You booked it in twenty-fourteen, and tonight's the night!

vo/q32.mp3.text: [whispers, panicked] He's a short seller! He's bet everything that you'll improve!

vo/z36.mp3.text: One push-up, and the currency breaks.

vo/b35.mp3.text: [tender, intense] Dale. Mate. I believe in you. One push-up. One push-up, and you're a whole new man.

vo/d37.mp3.text: What do I get if I do it?

vo/b38.mp3.text: Abs. Self-respect. Your father's approval... retroactively.

vo/z45.mp3.text: [moved] That is the most beautiful prospectus I have ever heard.

vo/d44.mp3.text: [quiet, sincere] You think I don't know? I know I'm never going. I've known since twenty-fifteen. I pay thirty-five bucks a month so I don't have to say it out loud.

vo/q46.mp3.text: [tearful] I'm putting my mom's savings in him.

vo/d47.mp3.text: [determined] Well. Not tonight. Tonight, I'm doing one push-up.

vo/q49.mp3.text: [panicked] He's going down! Andromeda just halted trading!

vo/d50.mp3.text: [strained, grunting] Getting down here... is already cardio.

vo/b51.mp3.text: [shouting] Down and up, Dale! Down and up!

vo/d53.mp3.text: [softly, pleasantly surprised] Oh, hey. That's where the remote went.

vo/d54a.mp3.text: [relaxed] You know what? It's actually really nice down here.

vo/q55.mp3.text: [screaming with joy] The peg holds! He did nothing! He did nothing, for all of us!

vo/s58.mp3.text: [flat, tired] Dale. Did you cancel the gym?

vo/b57.mp3.text: [panicking] No. No, no, no! I'm leveraged forty to one on his glutes!

vo/s60.mp3.text: [sighs] I swear, Dale. One more thing, and I'm leaving.

vo/q61.mp3.text: [hushed, awed] She's said that... four thousand times.

sfx/cheer.mp3.text: A huge distant stadium crowd erupts into cheering and applause

sfx/peel.mp3.text: Reality tears open: a huge ripping whoosh, then a deep cosmic bass boom and shimmering energy

sfx/holo.mp3.text: A sci-fi hologram projector powers on with a shimmering digital chime

sfx/tablet.mp3.text: Quick futuristic touchscreen typing beeps and bloops

sfx/holdmusic.mp3.text: Cheesy corporate telephone hold music: bland upbeat easy-listening bossa nova, electric piano and soft drum machine, instrumental

sfx/chaching.mp3.text: An old cash register cha-ching with a bell

sfx/doorburst.mp3.text: A front door is kicked open and slams hard against the wall

sfx/whistle.mp3.text: A sports coach blows a sharp referee whistle once

sfx/choir.mp3.text: A heavenly angelic choir sings one glorious sustained aaah chord, a divine reveal

sfx/alarm.mp3.text: A spaceship emergency alarm klaxon blaring repeatedly

sfx/beam.mp3.text: A sci-fi tractor beam hums loudly, then zaps upward with a whoosh

sfx/squeak.mp3.text: A tiny creature makes a small pathetic squeak

sfx/zipper.mp3.text: A long zipper being unzipped quickly

sfx/weakwhistle.mp3.text: A weak, feeble, out-of-breath toot on a referee whistle that fades pathetically

sfx/bike.mp3.text: A squeaky old exercise bike being pedalled slowly, rhythmic squeaks
